about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Aussie Burger with the Lot
recipes.summary: A beef patty piled with bacon, egg, beetroot, pineapple, cheese and tomato sauce on a toasted bun.
steps: Mix the mince with the salt and shape into four patties about 2cm thick. Press a dent into the middle of each.
Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 10 minutes, until soft and golden. Push to the side, add the bacon and cook for 4 minutes, until crisp.
Cook the patties on a hot barbecue plate or in the pan for 5 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through. Top each with cheese for the last minute, until melted.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and grill the pineapple for 1 minute each side, until lightly charred.
Build the burgers on the buns with lettuce, tomato, beetroot, pineapple, patty, bacon, egg, onion and tomato sauce.
notes: Food safety: burger patties must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Swap the beef for a vegetarian patty if you like, but check the label.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Hash with Poached Eggs
recipes.summary: Crisp spiced sweet potato and chickpeas topped with poached eggs, avocado and lime.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin, paprika and salt on a large tray and roast for 20 minutes, until browned.
Add the chickpeas and onion, toss and roast for 10 minutes, until the onion softens and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Bring a wide pan of water to a gentle simmer. Crack in the eggs one at a time and poach for 3 minutes, until the whites are set. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Divide the hash among plates and top with the eggs, avocado, coriander and a lime wedge.
notes: Food safety: poach the eggs until the whites are fully set; skip runny yolks for children, older adults and anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Macadamia-Crusted Chicken Schnitzel with Lemon
recipes.summary: Thin chicken fillets in a crunchy macadamia and panko crumb, shallow-fried and served with lemon.

items: 600g chicken breast, sliced in half horizontally

steps: Place the chicken between two sheets of baking paper and flatten to 1cm with a rolling pin. Season with salt.
Put the flour on one plate, the beaten eggs in a shallow bowl and the panko mixed with the macadamias on a third plate. Dust the chicken in flour, dip in egg, then press into the crumbs to coat.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and fry the schnitzels for 4 minutes each side, until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towel.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the lemon wedges.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with no pink inside. Keep the pan at medium so the crumb does not burn before the centre is cooked.
Serve with steamed greens or a pile of chips.

recipes.title: Chicken and Sweetcorn Pie with Mustard Cream
recipes.summary: A creamy chicken, leek and corn filling under a crisp puff pastry lid.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat and cook the chicken and leek for 8 minutes, until the chicken is no longer pink on the outside and the leek is soft.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the stock and milk gradually, stirring, and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick. Stir in the corn and mustard, season and cool for 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the filling into a 1.5L pie dish, cover with the pastry, trim and crimp the edges and brush with the egg.
Cut a small steam hole and bake for 30 minutes, until the pastry is puffed and golden and the filling is bubbling.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre and the filling must be piping hot. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.
Egg wash is raw egg on the pastry only; it is fully cooked in the oven.

recipes.title: Trofie al Pesto with Potato and Green Beans
recipes.summary: The Ligurian way: twisted pasta cooked with potato and beans, tossed through fresh basil pesto.

items: 150g green beans, cut into short lengths

steps: Blitz the basil, pine nuts, garlic, oil and cheese in a food processor with a pinch of salt until a coarse paste forms, adding a splash of cold water if it is thick.
Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the potato for 5 minutes. Add the pasta and cook for 8 minutes, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes, until the pasta is al dente.
Scoop out a mug of the cooking water, then drain. Return to the pot off the heat and toss with the pesto and enough cooking water to make it creamy.
notes: Vegetarian.
Add the pesto off the heat so the basil keeps its colour.

recipes.title: Provençal Chicken with Olives, Tomato and Thyme
recipes.summary: Bone-in chicken braised with ripe tomatoes, black olives, white wine and orange peel.
steps: Season the chicken. Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 10 minutes, until golden all over. Set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in the same pan for 6 minutes, until soft. Pour in the wine and boil for 2 minutes, until reduced by half.
Add the tomatoes, olives, orange peel and thyme, return the chicken and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Add the zucchini and cook uncovered for 10 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Piperade with Fried Eggs and Jamón
recipes.summary: A Basque pan of slowly stewed capsicum, onion and tomato topped with ham and fried eggs.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion, capsicum and garlic for 12 minutes, until very soft. Stir in the paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set.
Lay the prosciutto over the top and serve from the pan with bread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; skip runny yolks for children, older adults and anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free if served without bread.

recipes.title: Lomo Saltado (Peruvian Beef Stir-Fry with Chips)
recipes.summary: Beef, red onion and tomato wok-tossed with soy and vinegar, served over rice with oven chips.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chips with 1 tablespoon of oil and salt on a tray and bake for 30 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Cook the rice in a covered pot with 1 1/2 cups of water for 12 minutes, until the water is absorbed, then rest covered for 5 minutes.
Heat a wok over very high heat with the remaining oil and sear the beef in two batches for 2 minutes each, until browned. Set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic, onion and chilli for 2 minutes, until charred at the edges. Add the tomato, soy and vinegar and toss for 1 minute, then return the beef and cook for 1 minute.
Fold in the chips and coriander and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: beef strips are cooked once browned and hot through (at least 63°C). Keep cooked rice hot, or cool and refrigerate it within an hour.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Aji de Gallina (Peruvian Creamy Chicken)
recipes.summary: Shredded chicken in a mild, golden walnut and chilli sauce, served over potatoes with egg.
steps: Poach the chicken in the water with a pinch of salt over low heat for 18 minutes, until cooked through. Lift out, shred and keep 1 cup of the stock.
Soak the bread in the milk, then blitz with the walnuts and reserved stock until a smooth sauce forms.
Heat the oil in a deep pan over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic for 8 minutes, until soft. Stir in the chilli paste, turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the sauce and cheese, stir for 8 minutes until thick, then fold in the chicken and warm through for 3 minutes.
Serve over the potatoes with the egg and olives.
notes: Food safety: poached chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside; the finished dish must be piping hot.
Cook the eggs for 10 minutes so the yolks are firm.

recipes.title: Oaxacan-Style Black Bean Tlayudas
recipes.summary: Big crisp tortillas spread with garlicky black beans, melting cheese, cabbage, avocado and lime.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a small pan, cook the garlic and cumin for 1 minute, then add the beans with a splash of water and mash roughly for 4 minutes, until thick and spreadable.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Lay the tortillas on two trays and bake for 5 minutes, until stiff and lightly browned.
Spread the beans over the tortillas, scatter with the mozzarella and bake for 6 minutes, until the cheese has melted and the edges are crisp.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and the remaining oil, then pile onto the tortillas with the avocado, tomato, coriander and chilli.
notes: Vegetarian.
Use the biggest tortillas you can find; two per person makes a generous dinner.
